HTML comment ending with ---> (three dashes) must not drop content that follows (issue #339)

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>")
IO.inspect(result)
```
